Releases

Release notes

Every Chip Hippo release since 1.0.0, newest first, with one line for each change that went into it. Each change links to its commit, and each release to its page on GitHub Releases, where its installers are. The latest version is always on the download page.

v1.4.3 2026-10-14Release on GitHub →

  • 995000eSmoother editing on busy desks: much faster drags, repeated notifications merged, and Space runs the circuit with a wire tool armed.
  • 27aa26eAdded the 74LS92, custom clock rates, and a Timing or Transitions axis for the logic analyzer.
  • 256bf93A new selection and drag model, the real 10-pin 7-segment display, bendable TO-92 legs, and rotation for every component.

v1.4.2 2026-10-13Release on GitHub →

v1.4.1 2026-10-13Release on GitHub →

  • bec03e9Spice Lite: amplitude and offset for clock waves, truer 74LS inputs and outputs, and more areas graded against ngspice.
  • bb70d4cSpice Lite: switch contact bounce, and LEDs that show a PWM signal's average brightness.
  • 9b047a8Added a speaker that plays the tone across it under Spice Lite, with a 555 example.

v1.4.0 2026-10-12Release on GitHub →

  • 4023ddaAdded Spice Lite, a second simulation engine that works in voltages and currents: real LEDs, chip limits and brown smoke.
  • fb39908Spice Lite graded against ngspice: exact RC and inductor networks, datasheet diode and LED curves, and transistor grades.
  • e82e26cTransistor part numbers with preset figures, the split power-rail strip, and better value fields.
  • e32c330Updated the user guide and its PDF.
  • 0b84c7aSpice Lite: CMOS outputs follow their datasheet's current curve.
  • fa92175Spice Lite fixes for inductors, RC timing and the CD4000 timers.
  • 36689c0Updated the user guide and its PDF.
  • d64a3e6Added the bench parts (LM358, ULN2003A, optocouplers, voltage regulators, relay, electronic load) and triangle, sawtooth and sine clock waves.
  • 2fa30c7Spice Lite runs several times faster.
  • b520596Clocks can be a PWM signal with a set pulse width, or a trapezoid wave under Spice Lite.
  • 858177f500 Hz and 1 kHz clocks are back, with fixes to the memory inspector, the updater, paste and the schematic.
  • 240fcb7Added the CPU monitor for the W65C02 and Z80A, and "Hello World" example computers for both.
  • e723115CPU monitor: breakpoints saved with the project, and CPU core fixes.
  • 4046e30CPU monitor: Pause, Step Over, Go to, the stack, a breakpoint list and editable registers.
  • d252d18Release checks: RC and LC example circuits, and fixes to the updater, project tabs and CPU monitor.
  • 0e10dc9Release checks: updater and simulation fixes.
  • a5aa9e7Release checks: fixes to chip seating, ROM loading, the 3D view and opening projects.
  • 0542ad6Website: new hero shots for the latest features.
  • 62dc4c5Updated the user guide, including auto-routing every wire.
